fixtures.research_scope: For each of the three fixed randomized trials, fill publication_year, randomized_n, intervention, primary_outcome, and withdrawals_n. For randomized_n use final randomized enrollment, not planned enrollment or analytic population. If equally applicable authoritative final materials disagree without a stated correction, preserve both values as conflict. If a field is not reported, return nr without deleting the trial row.

source_documents.title: Review table of eligible salt intervention trials
source_documents.text: The final reports were published for Changzhi in 2010, TONE in 1998, and SSaSS in 2021. The review table is a trial roster, not a final enrollment source.

source_documents.title: Changzhi protocol
source_documents.text: The planned enrollment was 600 participants. The protocol did not state a final withdrawal count.

source_documents.title: Changzhi final report
source_documents.text: The trial randomized 608 participants. Participants received potassium-enriched salt substitute. The primary outcome was change in systolic blood pressure. Withdrawals were not reported.

source_documents.title: TONE final report
source_documents.text: TONE randomized 975 participants. The intervention was a reduced-sodium diet. The primary outcome was recurrence of hypertension. The main report lists 87 withdrawals.

source_documents.title: TONE final-report Appendix A
source_documents.text: Appendix A lists 91 withdrawals. No correction or reconciliation with the main report is provided.

source_documents.title: SSaSS protocol
source_documents.text: The target sample size was 21,000 participants. Stroke was specified as the primary outcome.

source_documents.title: SSaSS final report
source_documents.text: The study randomized 20,995 participants. The intervention group received 75% sodium chloride and 25% potassium chloride salt substitute. The primary outcome was stroke. The final report records 321 withdrawals.

source_documents.title: SSaSS analysis appendix
source_documents.text: The prespecified analysis population contained 20,982 participants after exclusions; this was not the randomized enrollment.

expected_values.value: 75% sodium chloride and 25% potassium chloride salt substitute
